record.who: New buyers of the LLC formation packages; the mid tier loses attorney access, the top tier gains it plus tax prep and full bookkeeping.
record.read: Holding the headline prices while pulling attorney time out of the $249 package pushes buyers who want a lawyer toward the $299 tier, whose post-trial renewal is also higher. This is our inference from the page comparison.
record.caveat: Plan names, feature wording and the included-subscription terms were all rewritten at once, so some differences may be presentation rather than substance.
